title: The Grunion Run, 2016 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The morning after the pup's first run: the fish he brought out of the surf on the garage step, stiff, and the pup guarding it. Wood with a shovel. The first dog never managed a fish; this one won't give his up.

panels.composition: The garage step. A small silver fish on it. The PUP sitting over it.

image.prompt: a small three-legged dog sitting protectively over a small silver fish on a concrete step, razor-sharp brush and ink

balloons.text: It's a fish. It's done being a fish.

a small three-legged dog refusing to move from over a fish on a step, razor-sharp brush and ink

panels.composition: WOOD sitting down on the step beside him instead. The shovel leaned on the wall.
